response_rate.label: Response rate
response_rate.definition: Number of received requests with an explicit entertainer response / number of received requests, using sent_at in the inclusive last 90 days; drafts are excluded.
response_rate.description: Viewing a page is not a response. Mark Reviewed records the first action with Viewed status; clarification records In Discussion. Other response actions record an explicit review first if needed.

average_response_time.label: Median response time
average_response_time.definition: Median elapsed hours from sent_at to the first explicit entertainer response for received requests sent in the inclusive last 90 days; unanswered requests are excluded.
average_response_time.description: Viewing a page is not a response. Mark Reviewed records the first action with Viewed status; clarification records In Discussion. Other response actions record an explicit review first if needed.

clarification_rate.label: Needs clarification
clarification_rate.definition: Number of received requests currently needing clarification / number of received requests sent in the inclusive last 90 days.

proposal_acceptance_rate.label: Proposal acceptance
proposal_acceptance_rate.definition: Number of requests with an accepted event after their first proposal_sent event / number of requests whose first proposal_sent event is in the inclusive last 90 days, grouped by clarity_level captured on that proposal; direct accepts and declines without a proposal are excluded.

filters.note: Event type is shared across views. Search applies only to the entertainer directory. Booking venue is context, not a data filter.

missing_request_details.message: This request is missing key details. Use 'Request Clarification' to ask before responding.

equipment_mismatch.condition: Known venue equipment does not satisfy entertainer.pricing.equipment_required_from_venue

missing_profile_pricing.condition: entertainer.pricing == null OR any required base rate, equipment, or typical duration field is missing
missing_profile_pricing.message: This entertainer hasn't added pricing details yet. Message them to discuss rates.

thresholds.overdue_condition: sent_at != null AND first_entertainer_action_at == null AND status is active AND response_due < runtime clock

assumptions: All records, event histories, profile bios, reviews, and booking notes are synthetic workshop examples.
The original sample identifiers, dates, names, budgets, and statuses are retained. Four short descriptions were expanded to satisfy the sending validation rule.
Profiles use intentional initials avatars; no external photos, real reviews, or external terms URLs are required.
Entertainer hourly prices and venue budgets remain separate; estimates round only for display.
An explicit review counts as a response. Merely opening a request does not. First-action fields mirror the first response event.
Stuck means active and days_in_stage > 14. Response overdue means no first response within five days of sending. Terminal requests do not trigger these alerts.
Full PA System satisfies Basic Sound Only. Unclear has unknown capabilities. Other capabilities are compared with the metadata map.
Send Proposal adopts the displayed venue budget for this workshop; no negotiation or dynamic quote engine is implied.
Proposal acceptance includes pending proposals in the denominator and excludes direct accepts/declines without a recorded proposal. Clarity is frozen at the first proposal.
Availability is unknown when the date is absent from the profile and no accepted request establishes a booking.
Data is fetched once; writes and undo remain in memory. Reload returns to the seed and restarts the anchored demo clock.

clock.description: Start at as_of on page load and advance with elapsed session time. Reload resets the demo.

clarity.definition: Needs Clarification when equipment is Unclear, duration is missing/nonpositive, or pricing_review_status is Needs Clarification; otherwise Clear.
clarity.proposal_snapshot: Freeze this value in clarity_level on the first proposal_sent event; subsequent clarification does not change historical grouping.

profile_content.review_provenance: Invented workshop examples, not real customer reviews.

items.performance_details: Acoustic sunset session for rooftop guests.
Close-up magic for a team-building evening.
All-day beach party with upbeat electronic music.
Poetry reading for a book launch and signing.
Quiet jazz accompaniment during the winter tasting menu.
Featured jazz trio in the courtyard; venue has no sound system.
Dinner jazz set; confirm whether the installed PA is operational.
